Subject: Mutual exit checklist & retention carveouts — AceroBank MAP

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (AceroBank_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and a focused SIG/CAIQ extract highlighting the fields you flagged. Key items we pulled into the MAP for clarity:

- Acceptance/exit criteria: SOC 2 Type II in-scope controls mapped + evidence owners
- DPA signoff and any contractual retention limits (we noted AceroBank wants a 7-year regulatory retention carveout for transaction records)
- Data residency & private deployment options (if transaction residency required in us-east-1 or on-prem)
- Escrow/KMS options for customer-managed keys and proposed escrow window
- Timeline: target pilot start 2026-09-01; production go-live range 2026-11-15 to 2026-12-01, contingent on the gates below

Proposed MAP exit gates (high-level):
1) SOC 2 Type II report provided or attestation date within past 12 months for Redwood production environment;
2) DPA fully executed with AceroBank legal (redlines resolved or signed);
3) SIG/CAIQ questionnaire responses accepted by your security team (we left open items in the SIG worksheet);
4) Data retention lanes agreed: transactional records retention (7 years) vs ephemeral logs (30 days by default, optional extended logging for audit purposes);
5) If transaction residency requirement cannot be satisfied by hosted, formal signoff on Private deployment or Dedicated capacity with regional isolation;
6) Escrow arrangement or KMS integration plan confirmed for long-term retention of encrypted artifacts.

Attachments: AceroBank_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP draft), SIG-CAIQ-responses-acerobank.xlsx (focused extract)

Next steps I propose:
- You and legal review the DPA redline we sent last week and flag must-have vs nice-to-have items (we can tolerate carveouts that don’t affect encryption/controls) — deadline: EOD next Tues (8/11)
- Security to review SIG sheet and list any open evidence owners by 8/11
- Internal sync (Redwood) — Kimberly and Priyom will finalize the KMS/escrow options and pricing delta for extended retention by 8/10

Happy to carve out time for a 30-min joint session with legal/security next week — does Thurs 8/6 11:00-11:30 PT work for you?

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

3) SIG: there are three unanswered items in the extract around key rotation, logical separation, and backup retention windows. Can your security team populate owners and timelines for those?
4) DPA redlines: legal will upload comments — please confirm a point person to triage legal questions.

We are aiming for a pilot start first week of September. If the transactional retention requirement mandates Private/on-prem, we need that identified this week to avoid schedule slip.

I can do Thu 8/6 11:00 PT for a short discussion — please send a calendar invite.

   - KMS: support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS with key policy restrictions and optional escrow to a third-party vault (we can propose IronVault as an example).
   - Retrieval SLA: standard archive retrieval (24-72 hours) or expedited (4 hours) at additional cost.
   - Pricing: one-time setup + per-GB/month tiered storage. I'll attach a short estimate after the call.

4) DPA triage: I can be the Redwood legal ops point person for negotiation. Please have AceroBank legal drop their redline PDF into the shared Drive folder and add short notes on the priority items.

I will join the Thu 8/6 11:00 PT call and bring a short appendix summarizing the escrow/KMS options and a draft DPA response plan.
